@graph.name: Website Audits for Hotels and Resorts
@graph.description: Hotels and resorts make up almost a quarter of the companies whose websites we reviewed in 2026. Guests always compare hotels, so we focus on what drives their choice: room descriptions, prices, booking terms, reviews, and the booking form. Unclear text or a broken button quickly sends a guest to another hotel.

@graph.name: Website Audits for Hotels and Resorts

mainEntity.name: Which pages of a hotel website should be checked first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rooms, prices and booking terms, the booking form, reviews, and contacts. These are the pages guests use to make their decision.

mainEntity.name: Do you check booking terms and loyalty programs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We often find errors in booking terms and loyalty programs, as well as differences from the primary version of the website.
